src/browser-llm-connections.ts.name: Model connections and host
src/browser-llm-connections.ts.description: Keeps the list of model provider connections (no keys) and answers NAP-LLM select and chat requests with chooser and consent.

src/browser-llm-models.ts.name: List provider models
src/browser-llm-models.ts.description: Fetches a connection's model list straight from the provider with an 8-second timeout, returns sorted unique model ids, and names CORS as a possible cause when the request fails.

src/browser-llm-panel.ts.name: Language models panel
src/browser-llm-panel.ts.description: Draws the Language models sidebar and its dialogs, and wires the connection store, vault and NAP-LLM host together.

src/browser-llm-vault.ts.name: Key vault
src/browser-llm-vault.ts.description: Encrypts remembered provider keys with a password-derived key (AES-GCM, minimum 12-character password) in host storage, or keeps a key for this session only.
